scope: One of two independent paired-budget generation slots for a v2 recovery task; the coordinator enforces the cumulative two-call/eight-candidate cap.

model.decoding_note: Use Codex service default; the CLI does not expose a temperature override.

budget.candidate_unit: candidate files; each file may define exactly one top-level pytest test function
budget.attempt_policy: Exactly one launch slot per call directory. Any process/model failure consumes the slot; no retry.
budget.token_usage_policy: Record service-reported usage when available. The 4096 output-token value is a requested target, not a guaranteed service hard limit.

validation.flakiness_rule: Reject a candidate if collection or any source-checkpoint execution run fails, times out, is unstable, or introduces a failure beyond the stable C1 baseline.
validation.correctness_rule: Retain only candidates whose asserted behavior is directly specified and whose blind review verdict is correct.
validation.base_suite_rule: Preserve the complete legal C1 base suite and hash-matched baseline audit.
validation.guided_rule: A retained Guided candidate must kill at least one named same-checkpoint surviving mutant in all three fresh runs.

data_policy.trajectory_provenance: Release snapshots and per-checkpoint agent_run_manifest.json are the frozen trajectories.
data_policy.file_backup_errors: Excluded from released legal base_tests packages and isolated under data/excluded_tests.
data_policy.hidden_and_future_data: Never supplied to generation, triage, review, or validation.
